plan.question: Does shared-row query/history gradient projection provide a repeatable validation AUC benefit over leaving gradients unchanged under both full and scale_half_tangent normalization, or mainly outperform a harmful norm replacement? Resolved seed-42 receipts show half-project minus no intervention is only +0.00002798084788568911 AUC, with +0.0000075492803423837795 Logloss and +33.06913763284683 wall seconds; full-project minus no intervention is +0.000015798219588525342 AUC with worse Logloss. Projection-minus-norm AUC is larger (+0.00025450792496473085 half; +0.0001943264311903281 full), but both norm controls underperform no intervention and both projection-minus-norm Logloss contrasts worsen. Candidate-authored two-batch snapshots report many negative row inner products alongside positive aggregate role cosine and small correction/total-gradient norm ratios. Retrieve evidence to distinguish repeatable ranking effects, degraded-control effects and an unverified Adam-update mediation hypothesis. Keep the six existing full/half by none/projection/norm cells fixed for any later authorized repetition; performance robustness alone would not establish conflict mediation.
missing_information: Independent-seed evidence is absent: exposed outcomes use seed 42, and deterministic replays do not supply repetitions. A later authorized interface must explicitly support paired seeds 43/44 for the fixed six cells; do not alter the frozen seed or emulate it inside candidate code. Report all paired contrasts, losses and costs, including reversals; separate adaptively selected seed-42 results from new-seed results.

Actual source bodies, checkpoints, initial tensors and data-order identities are not exported in this query phase. Before later execution, independently verify source/config/checkpoint lineage and common-state forward, scalar-loss and intended-gradient equality, including shared-row aggregation, unchanged paths, eligible rows, padding and norm floors. Receipt hashes and candidate-authored checks are provenance, not an independent implementation audit.

The norm control matches the hypothetical product-role sum norm at its own evolving state. It does not match the complete embedding gradient, Adam moments, actual updates or whole training trajectories. A separately admitted common-state audit with fixed optimizer state and independently verified decomposition is needed to distinguish direction changes from complete-gradient/update magnitude changes.

Conflict prevalence is available only from candidate-authored calls 0 and 512, under generic validation-scope metadata. Resolve the training-cache provenance and obtain predeclared, representative training-state summaries if authorized: magnitude-weighted row conflict, unchanged-path contribution and actual update direction/size. Row-count fractions and raw gradient norms alone do not establish optimizer mediation.

Per-example predictions and user-cluster identities are unavailable, so paired cluster-bootstrap intervals, slice precision and practical effect uncertainty cannot be reconstructed from aggregate AUC or sample counts. Existing slice reversals remain exploratory. Repeated seeds assess initialization robustness without removing adaptive validation-selection bias.

The paper-registry search for gradient surgery, PCGrad, shared parameters, Adam and norm-matched controls returned no matches. Nearest primary gradient-surgery and optimizer-aware control literature remains unresolved; a no-hit search is not novelty evidence. Scoped memory://agent-r0016 was resolved, including alternatives, falsifiers and negative trajectories. Prior QueryFormer/UniDot usage was considered-only, with no executed forward architecture transfer; no additional industry card is requested for this backward-control question.

Refresh the host ledger and actual execution/assessment tariffs before admitting work. All preparation, audits, complete control blocks, failures, repetitions and final assessment consume the budget. The current snapshot has about 51801 seconds and a 1760.9324324010606-second per-trial cap; this does not authorize execution or guarantee that two six-cell seed blocks plus final reserves fit. Admit complete blocks based on resources independently of observed quality, and retain the simpler no-intervention model in quality-cost comparisons.

No training, model-edit, seed-change or withheld-assessment interface is authorized here; retrieval-plan.json is the only editable output. Later execution requires a new phase contract. Freeze any final candidate/control/seed suite and exact artifacts before one closed assessment; withheld outcomes must remain outside open research memory. Current findings remain preliminary, and null or negative repetition must not trigger unrestricted seed-42 tuning.
